runtimeUpdate.title: Runtime update
runtimeUpdate.description: Attraccess cannot update this controller's runtime without a full reinstall. The only current path is re-running commissioning, which wipes applications, data and configuration on the CC100 and reinstalls from scratch. That is why it is not offered here as a one-click action. Automatic, non-destructive runtime updates are tracked in ATT-1099.

remove.title: Remove controller
remove.question: Remove {{name}} from Attraccess?
remove.description: This revokes MQTT access and removes the controller registration and configuration. Commissioning records with unfinished installation cleanup or management access recovery are retained. The runtime remains installed on the CC100. Removing a registration does not restore preexisting applications or data, or re-enable CODESYS. An active operation blocks removal.
